gaps.title: No real‑time temperature monitoring
gaps.detail: Frostbite’s emergency cold‑storage units are deployed quickly, but there’s no indication they capture live temperature data or send deviation alerts, which can risk food safety and compliance.
gaps.based_on: The company provides emergency cold storage solutions for hotels, restaurants, catering companies, event venues, supermarkets, food retailers, and commercial kitchens.

gaps.title: Lack of centralized asset visibility
gaps.detail: While they operate a fleet of 13 m³ high‑capacity trailers, the research shows no tracking or dashboard capability, meaning dispatch and utilization are likely managed manually.
gaps.based_on: Their equipment fleet includes 13 m³ high‑capacity trailers and a range of chillers and freezers.

gaps.title: Limited compliance & audit reporting
gaps.detail: Serving NHS trusts and major foodservice brands implies strict regulatory requirements, yet there’s no mention of automated compliance reporting that GND’s platform can provide.
gaps.based_on: It supplies NHS trusts and hospital facilities, as well as breweries and pub groups including Robinsons, Greene King, Holts, and Punch Pubs.

gaps.title: Resource constraints for IoT integration
gaps.detail: As a small, family‑run business with only ~70 LinkedIn followers, Frostbite may lack the in‑house engineering capacity to design and deploy custom sensor hardware across its fleet.
gaps.based_on: The company is family‑run and based in Warrington, UK.

pitch.angle: Frostbite’s rapid‑response cold‑storage service is a perfect match for GND’s ThinxFresh platform, which adds real‑time temperature analytics, automated compliance reporting and a single dashboard to keep every trailer and unit under constant watch—helping them protect food safety for high‑profile clients like the NHS and major food brands.
pitch.opener: Hi [Name], I noticed Frostbite delivers emergency refrigeration within 4 hours; imagine coupling that speed with live temperature alerts and compliance dashboards to safeguard every shipment.
